items.question: How does the story end?
items.expected: At the trial Alice grows to full size, says they're nothing but a pack of cards, the cards fly at her, and she wakes up on the bank with her sister - it was a dream.
items.answer: After Alice tells her sister about her curious dream, her sister kisses her, tells her it was a curious dream, and tells her to run in to tea because it is getting late [chunk 443]. Alice gets up and runs off, thinking about what a wonderful dream it had been [chunk 443]. Her sister sits still, leaning her head on her hand, watching the sunset and thinking about little Alice and her strange adventures, with her eyes bright and eager with tales of Wonderland of long ago, remembering her own child-life and happy summer days, leading to "THE END" [chunk 451, chunk 443].
items.reason: The actual answer correctly captures the ending of the story, noting that Alice wakes up from her dream and her sister reflects on it.
